{"metadata":{"description":"The most feature-complete DeepSeek Harness – Paseo integration project.","id":"gh:1333828198","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-acp-paseo","slug":"ds-hu/dsh-acp-paseo","topics":["acp","acp-bridge","agent-client-protocol","ai-agent","coding-agent","cordis","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-bundle","dsh-plugin","monorepo","paseo","paseo-plugin","typescript"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"The most feature-complete DeepSeek Harness – Paseo integration project."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-acp-paseo"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**DeepSeek Harness in Paseo.** Connect DeepSeek Harness to Paseo with real-time token streaming, in-"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"app DSH preset selection, live model switching, cross-profile session persistence, and native questi"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"reset selection, live model switching, cross-profile session persistence, and native question cards."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English · 中文 · 日本語 · Français · 한국어"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"npm: @ds-hu/dsh-acp-paseo · @ds-hu/dsh-acp-plus"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## English"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### Why choose this plugin"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"This plugin delivers real-time token streaming, live reasoning inspection, cross-profile session per"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"sistence, in-app DSH preset selection, live model switching, and native interactive question cards f"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"or DeepSeek Harness inside Paseo."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Key advantages over other plugins:
- **True token-level streaming**: Text and thinking steps appear "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"in real time with an instant stop button; other plugins wait until the entire turn finishes before o"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"utputting text.
- **In-app preset, model & permission switching**: Choose a DSH agent preset for a n"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ew task (when your profile declares presets), and switch models, reasoning effort, approval policies"},{"id":"p9s5","text":", sandbox confinement, and plan mode directly from Paseo's composer; other plugins treat the model s"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"elector as cosmetic.
- **Persistent sessions shared across profiles**: Reopen past chats seamlessly "},{"id":"p9s7","text":"after reloads or restarts; sessions live in DSH's global session store and are shared with DSH Web, "},{"id":"p9s8","text":"TUI, and other profiles, solving the fresh-sessions-only limitation of other plugins.
- **Native int"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"eractive question cards**: Interactive questions asked by DSH render as native Paseo cards with sing"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"le-choice, multiple-choice, and custom text inputs.
- **Fine-grained approvals & MCP support**: Conf"},{"id":"p9s11","text":"ine tools with one-shot allow-once decisions while keeping full support for Paseo MCP servers."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### Feature showcase"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"*1. Pick from all models automatically discovered from your DSH profile.*"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"*2. Watch text and reasoning stream live token-by-token with an instant stop control.*"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"*3. Inspect file reads, code edits, shell commands, reasoning, and context window usage in one unifi"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ile reads, code edits, shell commands, reasoning, and context window usage in one unified timeline.*"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"*4. Choose the DSH agent preset for a new task — Standard, PTC, Minimal, or Creator.*"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"*5. Switch models, reasoning effort, approval rules, sandbox confinement (Read only / Workspace writ"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"e / Danger full access), and plan mode directly in the composer.*"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"*6. Answer interactive questions from DSH through native cards with options and custom answers.*"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"*7. Sensitive actions outside the workspace prompt for one-time approval without granting blanket ac"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"nsitive actions outside the workspace prompt for one-time approval without granting blanket access.*"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### How to use"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"1. Add the bundle to the DSH `acp-plus` profile:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"2. Install the Paseo plugin from npm:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"3. Add the provider entry under `agents.providers` in `~/.paseo/config.json`:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"4. Enable the plugin in **Settings → Plugins**, then choose **DeepSeek Harness** when creating a new"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"le the plugin in **Settings → Plugins**, then choose **DeepSeek Harness** when creating a new agent."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Paseo lists the DSH agent presets declared in your `acp-plus` profile (for example Standard, PTC, Mi"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"nimal, and Creator). Pick one when starting a task; DSH locks the preset after the first turn."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## 中文"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### 为什么选择本插件"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"本插件为 Paseo 带来真实逐 Token 流式输出、实时思考过程、跨 Profile 会话持久化与共享、新建任务时选择 DSH 预设、界面内动态切换模型以及原生交互式提问卡片。"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"相比其他插件的独有优势：
- **真·逐 Token 流式输出**：生成内容与思考过程实时流式呈现，随时可通过停止按钮打断；其他插件通常只能在整个回合结束后一次性输出完整文本。
- **新建任务时选择"},{"id":"p30s2","text":" DSH 预设，界面内切换模型与权限**：在 Paseo 输入栏选择 Profile 中声明的 DSH Agent 预设（如标准、PTC、极简、创造），并直接切换模型、思考深度、审批策略、沙箱隔离与计"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"划模式；其他插件的模型选择通常仅为静态展示，无法改变底层实际运行路由。
- **跨 Profile 会话持久化与互通**：完整保留 DSH 原生 Session ID，刷新或重启后直接恢复；会话写入 "},{"id":"p30s4","text":"DSH 全局会话库，与 DSH Web、TUI 及其他 Profile 完全共享互通，避免其他插件会话只能临时单次使用的痛点。
- **原生交互式提问卡片**：DSH 发起的提问直接映射为 Paseo"},{"id":"p30s5","text":" 原生问题卡片，支持单选、多选与自由补充输入。
- **细粒度单次工具审批与 MCP 支持**：危险操作支持单次授权（Allow once），避免过度提权；同时原生兼容 Paseo MCP 工具链，无"},{"id":"p30s6","text":"支持单选、多选与自由补充输入。
- **细粒度单次工具审批与 MCP 支持**：危险操作支持单次授权（Allow once），避免过度提权；同时原生兼容 Paseo MCP 工具链，无需关闭 MCP。"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"### 功能展示"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"*1. 自动同步 DSH Profile 中的所有可用模型，点击即可选用。*"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"*2. Token 逐字流式打印，思考过程即时可见，提供随时可用的中断按钮。*"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"*3. 文件读取、代码编辑、Shell 运行、思考过程与上下文用量汇聚于同一时间线。*"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"*4. 新建任务时选择 DSH Agent 预设——标准、PTC、极简或创造。*"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"*5. 在输入栏切换模型、思考深度、审批规则、沙箱隔离（只读/工作区写入/完全访问）及计划模式。*"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"*6. DSH 的交互式提问化身为原生表单，支持选项点选、自定义输入与提交。*"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"*7. 超出工作区的危险操作发起单次审批询问，一键允许或拒绝，保护本地环境安全。*"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"### 怎么用"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"1. 创建 DSH 的 `acp-plus` Profile 并添加 npm 插件包："},{"id":"p41s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"2. 安装 Paseo 插件："},{"id":"p43s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p44s1","text":"3. 在 `~/.paseo/config.json` 的 `agents.providers` 下配置："},{"id":"p45s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p46s1","text":"4. 在 **Settings → Plugins** 中启用插件，新建 Agent 时选择 **DeepSeek Harness** 即可开始。"},{"id":"p47s1","text":"Paseo 会列出 `acp-plus` Profile 中声明的 DSH Agent 预设（例如标准、PTC、极简、创造）。新建任务时选择；首轮对话开始后 DSH 会锁定预设。"},{"id":"p48s1","text":"## 日本語"},{"id":"p49s1","text":"### なぜこのプラグインを選ぶのか"},{"id":"p50s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
